description: This source file contains the code-behind for the MCQExam page of an online examination system. It manages loading multiple-choice questions from a database, displaying them on the page, handling user responses, timing the exam, and submitting results to the database.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQExam ASP.NET page, handling loading questions, user interactions, timing, and submission logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; initializes questions from the database based on the selected course and exam timer settings.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected options, records the result in the database, and navigates to the exam result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the exam timer display and handles timeout when time expires.
